title: A new way to compare schools
summaryZh: 英格兰的新学校资料工具集中展示出勤、成绩和早餐俱乐部等信息，部分比较功能仍待扩展。

sentences.text: On 13 November 2026, the Department for Education launched a new online tool to help parents choose a school in England.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月13日，教育部推出一款新线上工具，帮助家长选择英格兰的学校。

sentences.text: It brings different kinds of school information together in one place.
sentences.zh: 它把不同类型的学校信息集中到一处。

sentences.text: Parents can use the profiles to check a school’s location and the ages of its pupils.
sentences.zh: 家长可以利用学校资料查看学校的位置和学生的年龄范围。

sentences.text: They can also find information about attendance, results and services such as free breakfast clubs.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以了解出勤、成绩及免费早餐俱乐部等服务。

sentences.text: For older children, the profiles will include information about GCSE subjects.
sentences.zh: 对于年龄较大的孩子，学校资料将包含GCSE考试科目的信息。

sentences.text: They will also show what pupils did after year 11, such as further study or work.
sentences.zh: 资料也将展示学生在11年级之后的去向，例如继续学习或工作。

sentences.text: The tool is available as primary school applications open in every local area.
sentences.zh: 在各地小学申请开放之际，这款工具开始可用。

sentences.text: Parents have until January to choose a school for their family.
sentences.zh: 家长可以在截至一月的申请期内为孩子选择学校。

sentences.text: At launch, parents can compare secondary schools side by side.
sentences.zh: 在推出时，家长可以并排比较中学。

sentences.text: This comparison feature will later become available for primary schools too.
sentences.zh: 之后小学也将可以使用这个比较功能。

sentences.text: Ofsted inspection reports are planned for next year, while information about more activities outside lessons will be added in coming years.
sentences.zh: 计划明年加入Ofsted督学机构的检查报告，未来几年还将添加更多课外活动信息。

sentences.note: will later become…说明未来将有的功能，不能与已经开放的功能混淆。

questions.text: What information would you look for when choosing a school?
questions.zh: 选择学校时，你会寻找哪些信息？

expressions.note: 原创口语练习表达，不是原报道引文。
